note: Literature indicates universal or near-universal developmental/speech delay and congenital heart defects (including ASD and VSD) in up to 78% of individuals.

evidence.text: All evaluated individuals with KDM2B CxxC variants presented with developmental delay predominantly in speech and motor domains, while congenital heart defects occurred in up to 78% of individuals.

source.title: KDM2B variants in the CxxC domain impair its DNA-binding ability and cause a distinct neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: All individuals with CxxC variants presented with developmental delay, mainly in the speech and motor domain, in addition to variable intellectual disability and mild facial dysmorphism. Congenital heart defects were observed in up to 78% of individuals

evidence.text: The core phenotype of KDM2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder features speech and motor delay, intellectual disability, and congenital heart defects such as atrial septal defect and ventricular septal defect.

source.title: KDM2B‐Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder A Case‐Series Supporting the CxxC Domain Phenotype With Emphasis on Ocular and Dermatologic Features
